definition: Techniques for visualizing which tokens a transformer model's attention mechanism is focusing on when processing a given input.
details: Attention visualization can offer intuitive (though sometimes misleading) insight into a model's processing, and has been used both as an interpretability tool and, more critically, studied for how faithfully it actually reflects the model's true decision-making process.
story: Imagine a factory floor where each workstation can glance at every other workstation before doing its part. In plain words: Techniques for visualizing which tokens a transformer model's attention mechanism is focusing on when processing a given input. Here is how it actually plays out: Attention visualization can offer intuitive (though sometimes misleading) insight into a model's processing, and has been used both as an interpretability tool and, more critically, studied for how faithfully it actually reflects the model's true decision-making process. Structure decides what the model can even express — the blueprint before the bricks. That blueprint is Attention Visualization.
